build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where a ball must fall into a jar through a hole in a bar
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable size and position in the PHYRE scene
create_static_bar_with_hole: create two static bars with a gap forming a hole for the ball to pass through
create_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar object positioned below the bar to catch the falling ball
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball to be inside the jar using phantom vertices
